sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.12989 of 2017
Order:

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Panchayat Raj and Rural Development and learned Standing Counsel for Gram Panchayat for the respondents and perused the entire material on record.
2. This petition is filed questioning the action of the respondent Nos.4 and 5

herein are trying to dispossess the petitioners from the respective extents of Ac.0.05 gts., 0.06 gts., 0.08  gts., 0.08  and Ac.0.06 gts., totaling to an extent of Ac.0.34 gts., in Sy.No.209/U and 209/Uu of Chinnametpalli Village, Koratla Mandal, Jagitial District even without following due process of law as illegal and arbitrary.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that at the stage of admission, this Court has granted interim order on 12.04.2017 in W.P.M.P.No.16142 of 2017 in W.P.No.12989 of 2017, directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the subject lands of the ::2::
petitioners.
However, the order will not preclude the respondents from proceeding in accordance with law.
4. In spite of lapse of more than seven (07) years, the respondents did not choose to filed counter-affidavit or vacate petition denying the averments made by the petitioners in the writ affidavit.
5. In view of the same, the writ petition is disposed of, directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioners' property without following due process of law.

If the respondents want to acquire the land of the petitioner, they have to follow the procedure as contemplated under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
